description: This file contains implementation of JSON handling classes and functions within the WPEFramework project, including error message formatting, static tag definitions, and debug string generation for JSON variants.

classes.name: IElement
classes.description: Interface class for JSON elements with static tag definitions.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Represents a JSON value with various types and provides debug string output.

classes.name: VariantContainer
classes.description: Container for multiple Variants with debug string output.

methods.name: ErrorDisplayMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message with context and position information.

methods.name: Variant::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a formatted debug string representing the Variant's value.

methods.name: VariantContainer::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a concatenated debug string of all contained Variants.
